name: Osiecki Family Foundation Clinical Placement Scholarship (SCU)
summary: Up to $5,000 for SCU health and lifestyle or naturopathic medicine students doing regional, rural or remote clinical placements.
key: Up to $5,000 for regional, rural or remote external placements, or up to $1,000 for travel to SCU clinics.
who: Enrolled in the Bachelor of Health Science (Health and Lifestyle) and/or the Master of Naturopathic Medicine.
Doing an external clinical placement, generally outside major cities.
how: Apply through the National Centre for Naturopathic Medicine Scholarship Application Form during an open round.
catches: Next round is open from 8 October to 13 November 2026.
Be ready to supply evidence of placement costs.
